title: 038 vote C (multi-Holt) as SimpleTrigger entry triggers: holt_vote_up (momentum) and its long-only fade holt_vote_fade (reversion), each alone vs its family reference and beside the width book
label: PROVISIONAL -- one era (2023-26); vote C was chosen with both halves in view (038 post-hoc, preregistration_vote.json), so neither half is blind. Nothing is adopted.

why_these.st_holt_up: 038's only both-halves-positive cell: vote C (Holt 32/64/128/256, 3 of 4 > +30 bp, N=48) net +10.1 / +7.5 bp, edge +20 / +34 bp, INCONCLUSIVE (late lb -19 bp), forward window -42 bp
why_these.st_holt_fade: the user's fade arm after the TS_ForecastPlot inspection: in the last 14 days up-signals were followed by -106 bp over 12 h; on spot the up-signal cannot be shorted, so the long-only mirror buys when 3 of 4 forecast < -30 bp

signals: research/outcomes/holt_triggers.py: damped Holt (utils/Forecasters.py HOLT, no detrending/smoothing) on the trailing 32/64/128/256 log closes, forecast 48 candles ahead, at every 16th candle on a fixed date grid (epoch candle index % 16 == 0); a candle without 256 closes of history does not vote. Data-keyed forecast cache (seeded from 038; never read by causality checks).
setup: st_holt_up inherits st_g24_mom (SimpleTrigger_BreakoutGbb_MomExit_G24: momentum exits, 24 h grace, hold window); st_holt_fade inherits st_fam_gbb (SimpleTrigger_FamGbb, ARM_D_FAMILY reversion exits); only TRIGGER_NAME differs. config_wf; 15 folds f00-f14; startup_candle_count 64 as the comparators, so the first ~192 candles (~2 days) of each 90-day fold cannot vote (Holt-256 needs 256 closes).
instrument: trigger causality PASS (research/outcomes/causality.py --write with HOLT_TRIGGER_NOCACHE=1, all triggers re-run); no zero-trade half; arm trades >= 100 over 15 folds, else INCONCLUSIVE
alone: judge_one(arm, its family comparator) (early gain > 0, late gain > 0, paired and risk not WORSENED; rule maps below)
beside_width_book: evaluation/books.py combine + shared_wallet (one wallet of stake x max_open_trades; refused and shrunk entries counted) of [w_aro, arm] vs w_aro alone: PASS = combined early AND late totals above w_aro's, AND the whole-period paired verdict (halves.split, split_after f14) not WORSENED; same-pair overlaps between the books reported (they need two sub-accounts)
decision: per arm: 'candidate trigger' if either verdict PASSes; both reported with p values
note: 038 measured the vote with a fixed 12 h hold; these arms use the framework's family exits, so the result tests the entry inside the real exit stack.
